title: Stock Selloff Extends to Asia as Chip Rout Deepens: Markets Wrap
summary: A selloff in equities spread to Asia after chip stocks tumbled on Wall Street, as hotter-than-expected US inflation fueled bets on more aggressive Federal Reserve rate hikes. Treasuries rallied.

title: Chip Rout Deepens as Rate Fears Collide With AI Funding Woes

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Oct. 15
summary: Oil held a gain as a flare-up in attacks from Russia to the Middle East threatened supply that only recently recovered to near pre-Iran War levels.

title: Bolivia Revamps Gold Export Rules in Bid to Attract Dollars
summary: Bolivia aims to boost private gold exports while increasing dollar inflows to domestic banks in a reform backed by President Rodrigo Paz that ends a three-year-old system overseen by the central bank.

title: Gold Holds Loss as Hot Inflation Lifts October Rate-Hike Bets
summary: Gold held a decline as a jump in US inflation stoked worries the Federal Reserve will have to raise interest rates further to keep prices under control.

title: India's NIIF Eyes $800M Data Center Investment
summary: The National Investment and Infrastructure Fund (NIIF) is likely to draw as much as $3.2 billion in investments for one of its entities and between $700 million to $800 million of that will go to data centers, Chief Executive Officer Sanjiv Aggarwal told Bloomberg's Yvonne Man in an interview on the sidelines of the Bloomberg New Economy Forum in New Delhi. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: China’s Backdoor Bond-Buying Talk Swirls on $600 Billion Buildup
summary: Like many on Wall Street, DoubleLine’s Vitaliy Liberman has made a habit out of keeping tabs on foreign ownership of US debt securities, looking for signs of any broad-based pullback in retaliation for Donald Trump’s zero-sum trade policies. Month after month, he noticed something peculiar.

title: Susan Collins Wasn’t the Check on Trump That Was Needed, Says Poersch
summary: In discussion with Bloomberg Government reporter Jonathan Tamari, Senate Majority PAC president JB Poersch explains why Susan Collins wasn't the check on Trump that the Democrats needed. They speak at a Bloomberg.com subscriber-only event in Washington, DC on October 14, 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Top Forecaster Says Fed May Hike Rates Half a Point in December
summary: A forecaster who was early to call the most recent Federal Reserve rate hike now says a bigger, half-percentage-point rate increase could be on the table in December.

title: Woman Admits Trying to Scam Wes Edens for $1.2 Billion
summary: A woman pleaded guilty to fraud in connection with a plot to extort Fortress Investment Group co-founder Wes Edens out of more than $1.2 billion by threatening to release videos of them having sex.

title: TSMC Results Face High Bar to Calm Global AI Stock Trade Jitters
summary: With strong earnings from global chip majors failing to boost the AI trade, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. faces a high bar to impress investors.

title: Huel CEO on Danone Deal and Expansion to US Retail
summary: Huel CEO James McMaster discusses Danone’s roughly $1.2 billion acquisition of the UK-based meal-replacement and protein-shake maker. He says Huel established local manufacturing and warehouses when it entered the U.S. about eight years ago, and has since grown internationally; the company views Danone as the right partner to take it to its next stage. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Loop Capital CEO on Expanding Athlete Wealth Platform
summary: Loop Capital is buying $450 million in client assets from Lifeline Capital to expand its wealth management business and serve more athletes and entertainers. Founder, Chairman and CEO Jim Reynolds said the firm encourages athletes to invest in companies and gain ownership rather than rely on short-term endorsement payments. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: S&P 500 Ends Longest Streak of Calm Since 2020 as AI Trade Sinks
summary: The US stock market’s longest streak of tranquility since before the Covid-19 pandemic is over.

title: Canadian Lender Cash Today Inc. Under Scrutiny as 44,000 Loans Vanish
summary: A Canadian consumer lender has left creditors with potential claims of more than C$613 million ($430 million), while a court-appointed receiver struggles to account for the firms’ loans and determine how investor money was used.

title: Why Inflation Numbers Are Disappointing
summary: While inflation numbers might not be disastrous, they’re still disappointing and moving in the wrong direction. Bloomberg Opinion columnist John Authers explains where this leaves the US, and if it will lead to any more rate hikes from the Fed. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Container Ship Sinks in Strait of Hormuz as Attacks Ramp Up
summary: A cargo ship sank in the Strait of Hormuz after a strike that sparked a fire and the evacuation of crew members, the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore said.
